answer: Operator-Linked Sweep Account: each new identity draws from an operator-level reserve posted as an ocean of locked capital. If any wallet from the same operator is caught sybil-clustering, the sweep seizes the entire reserve, not just that wallet. An attacker must therefore over-collateralize every identity at full-reserve scale; costs scale linearly with sybil count while a single detection liquidates all. New operators earn a nectar reward for verified clean history, and disputes route through a willow-slow arbitration window before sweep finalizes.
